verdict.rationale: Docs show a genuine no-cost path: CockroachDB Cloud Serverless scales Request Unit consumption to zero when idle (docs-18) and there's a $400 free-trial-credit quickstart (docs-8, docs-25), plus local `cockroach demo`/single-node modes for offline prototyping (docs-1, docs-2). However, community feedback repeatedly notes core operational features (backup/restore, follower-reads, CDC, multi-region) are enterprise-gated (comm-8, comm-9, comm-2), which could limit how 'real' a prototype can get before hitting paywalls. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the free/serverless tier alone supports a full realistic prototype without early enterprise-feature friction, and explicit ongoing (non-trial) free tier limits/quotas documentation.
